extracted.intended_audience: applicants and their agents seeking to register designs under the Patents, Designs, and Trade Marks Act 1883 (UK)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and instructions for applying for registration of industrial designs under the Patents, Designs, and Trade Marks Act 1883, covering forms, fees, representations (drawings/specimens), procedure, hearings, appeals, marking, inspection, and related formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees payable under Designs Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The fees to be paid under the Act as they relate to applications for and registration of designs shall be the fees specified in the First Schedule hereto.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed fee items given in First Schedule (e.g., 10s for application for single articles classes 1–12; 1s for classes 13–14; fees for search, inspection, certificates, correction of clerical errors, copies, etc.). All fees payable by stamped forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form of application (Form E)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application for the registration of a design shall be made in the Form E in the Second Schedule hereto.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remaining forms in Schedule may be used where applicable. Form E corresponds to Form E in the Act's schedule; stamped copies available for different classes (classes 1–12 and classes 13–14).

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of goods
rubrics_metrics.description: For purposes of registration of designs goods are classified in the manner appearing in the Third Schedule hereto.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must identify the class in which their design falls (affects fees and marking requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications may be via authorised agent
rubrics_metrics.description: All communications between an applicant for registration and the Comptroller or Board of Trade may be made by or through an agent duly authorised to the satisfaction of the Comptroller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlike patent applications, an application for registration of a design may be signed by an agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where and how to file application
rubrics_metrics.description: An application for registration, with the prescribed fee, shall be left at the Patent Office, Designs Branch, or sent prepaid by post addressed to the Comptroller at the Patent Office (Designs Branch).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address: Comptroller, Patent Office (Designs Branch), 25 Southampton Buildings, Chancery Lane, London. Applications sent by post are deemed left when the letter would be delivered in ordinary course of post; proving proper addressing and posting is sufficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Size and format of papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications and all drawings, sketches, photographs, or tracings and other documents must be written, printed, copied, or drawn upon strong wide-ruled foolscap paper (one side only) size 13 inches by 8 inches, leaving a margin of not less than one inch and a half on the left-hand part.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signatures must be written in a large and legible hand. The Comptroller may vary these requirements in any particular case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required representations (drawings/specimens)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application shall be accompanied by a sketch or drawing, or by three exactly similar drawings, photographs, or tracings of the design, or by three specimens of the design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The applicant must state whether design is applicable for the pattern or for the shape/configuration and the means by which it is applicable. If one sketch is sent to secure immediate registration, three similar drawings must be sent afterwards. When articles cannot be pasted into books, drawings/photographs/tracings must be furnished.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fixing and quality of drawings/tracings
rubrics_metrics.description: When sketches, drawings, or tracings are furnished they must be fixed; drawings on tracing paper cannot be received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If tracings are supplied they must be done on tracing cloth or mounted on thick paper. Rough sketches cannot be accepted. Drawings should be sent in triplicate on specified paper size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimen size limit
rubrics_metrics.description: When specimens of the design are furnished instead of drawings they must be of such a nature as can be pasted into books and the dimensions of each specimen must not exceed 12 inches by 21 inches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specimens must be suitable for filing and examination in the Office; not for large or unpasteable articles (use drawings/photographs instead).

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of views accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Only two views of the same design can be accepted, unless in the case of a design for a set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the design is for a set, multiple views showing arrangements of application across articles should be provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate date procedure (single sketch then three drawings)
rubrics_metrics.description: If it is desired to secure a date of registration at once, one sketch may be sent with the application; in this case the design, if accepted, will be registered as of the date received but no certificate will be issued until three exact drawings or specimens have been sent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, applicant may send three exactly similar drawings, photographs, or specimens initially to be complete in the first instance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of nature of design
rubrics_metrics.description: The application must, in describing the nature of the design, state whether it is applicable for the pattern or for the shape or configuration of the design, and the means by which it is applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Representations should not be accompanied by lengthened explanatory statements; brief description only for identification (especially if exhibition prior to registration).

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgement of receipt
rubrics_metrics.description: On receipt of an application for registration the Comptroller shall send to the applicant an acknowledgment thereof.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledgement confirms filing and date of receipt which becomes date of registration upon sealing of certificate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of registration
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Comptroller determines to register a design he shall as soon as may be send to the applicant a certificate of such registration in the prescribed form, sealed with the seal of the Patent Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form of certificate referenced in Designs Forms (Form G). The day the application was received is deemed the date of registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postal service deemed filing rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Any application, notice, or other document required to be left or given at the Patent Office may be sent by prepaid letter through the post, and if so sent shall be deemed to have been left/made/given at the time when the letter would be delivered in ordinary course of post.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In proving service it is sufficient to prove the letter was properly addressed and put into the post.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice before adverse exercise of discretion (hearing by Comptroller)
rubrics_metrics.description: Before exercising any discretionary power given to the Comptroller adversely to an applicant, the Comptroller shall give him ten days' notice of the time when he may be heard personally or by his agent before the Comptroller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This implements section 94 of the Act; ensures applicant chance to be heard prior to adverse action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant to notify intention to be heard
rubrics_metrics.description: Within five days from the date when such notice would be delivered in the ordinary course of post, the applicant shall notify the Comptroller whether or not he intends to be heard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time allowed is five days from the day the notice would be delivered (not five days after actual receipt).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of Comptroller's decision
rubrics_metrics.description: The decision or determination of the Comptroller in exercise of discretionary powers shall be notified to the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are formally informed of outcomes of hearings and determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeal to the Board of Trade (notice and grounds)
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the Comptroller refuses to register a design and the applicant intends to appeal to the Board of Trade, he shall, within one month from the date of the decision appealed against, leave at the Patent Office (Designs Branch) a notice of such intention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice must be accompanied by a statement of the grounds of appeal and of the applicant's case in support thereof; a copy must be sent forthwith to the Secretary of the Board of Trade. Form F available for notice of appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board of Trade hearing directions and notice
rubrics_metrics.description: The Board of Trade may give such directions as they think fit for the purpose of the hearing of the appeal; seven days' notice (or such shorter as the Board directs) of the time and place of hearing shall be given to the Comptroller and the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Board may manage hearing process and shorten or lengthen notices as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registering a design (entries on sealing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon the sealing of a certificate of registration the Comptroller shall cause to be entered in the register of designs the name, address, and description of the registered proprietor, and the date upon which the application was received (deemed the date of registration).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Register entry is official record of proprietorship and date; affects rights and enforcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for subsequent proprietors / transfer entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a person becomes entitled to the copyright in a registered design, or to any share or interest therein, a request for the entry of his name in the register shall be addressed to the Comptroller and left at the Patent Office (Designs Branch).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The request must be signed appropriately (individual, firm member, or authorised agent), state name/address/description of claimant and particulars of assignment/transmission, be accompanied by a statutory declaration verifying statements, and the claimant shall furnish such other proof of title as the Comptroller may require. Corporate bodies may be registered by corporate name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duty when Court order obtained under s.90
rubrics_metrics.description: Where an order has been made by the Court under section 90 of the Act, the person in whose favour such order has been made shall forthwith leave at the Patent Office an office copy of such order and the register shall be rectified or the purport of such order otherwise entered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Court orders affecting proprietorship must be lodged to correct the register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comptroller's power to dispense with evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: If a person required to do an act, sign a document, make a declaration, or produce evidence is unable to do so for reasonable cause, the Comptroller, with sanction of the Board of Trade and upon production of other evidence and subject to such terms, may dispense with that act/document/declaration/evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to avoid unfair procedural bar where strict compliance is impossible; Board sanction required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment and correction of documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Any document, drawings, sketches, or tracings for the amending of which no special provision is made by the Act may be amended, and any irregularity in procedure which the Comptroller thinks may be obviated without detriment to interests of any person may be corrected, upon such terms as he may direct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes correction of clerical errors (see specific rule and Form P/Forms for correction).

rubrics_metrics.name: Enlargement of time by Comptroller
rubrics_metrics.description: The time prescribed by these Rules for doing any act or taking any proceeding may be enlarged by the Comptroller, if he thinks fit, and upon such terms as he may direct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for deadlines and payments (e.g., renewal deadlines); formal application (see Forms) and may incur terms/conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marking of goods bearing registered designs
rubrics_metrics.description: Before delivery on sale of any article to which a registered design has been applied, the proprietor shall, if the article is included in classes 1–12, cause each such article to be marked with the abbreviation 'R' and the number appearing on the certificate; if included in classes 13–14, cause each such article to be marked with the abbreviation 'REG'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classes 13 and 14 include printed or woven designs on textile piece goods, handkerchiefs, and shawls. Marking during the period of copyright is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of registered designs
rubrics_metrics.description: On such days and during such hours as the Comptroller shall determine and notify, any person paying the prescribed fee may, on production of the number of any design whose copyright has ceased, inspect such design, and any person paying the prescribed fee may take a copy or copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fee: 1s for each quarter of an hour for inspection; copies charged according to agreement. See S.52 for right to inspect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificates by Comptroller for legal proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a certificate is required for legal proceedings or other special purpose as to any entry, matter, or thing the Comptroller may, on a written request and on payment of the prescribed fee, give such certificate and specify on the face of it the purpose for which it has been requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Forms for request and certificate given in the designs forms (Form I and Form J); fee specified in First Schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searches on production of sketch of design
rubrics_metrics.description: The Comptroller may, on receipt of the prescribed fee, make searches among designs registered at the Patent Office after commencement of the Act, and inform any person whether a particular design produced and to be applied to goods in a particular class is identical with or an obvious imitation of any registered design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search requests and fees covered by schedule (see section 53). Useful pre-filing check against infringement/novelty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice and requirements for industrial/international exhibitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Any person desirous of exhibiting a design or article to which a design has been applied at an industrial or international exhibition, or of publishing a description of a design during the period of the exhibition, shall, after obtaining from the Board of Trade a certificate that the exhibition is industrial or international, give the Comptroller seven days' notice in writing of his intention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For identifying the design later, the applicant shall furnish a brief description accompanied by a sketch or drawing and such other information the Comptroller may require. Form L is provided for notice of intended exhibition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings and photographs instructions (triplicate, size, sets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings accompanying an application must be sent in triplicate, each representation on strong foolscap paper one side only of size 13 in. by 8 in.; when the design is to be applied to a set, each drawing should show various arrangements for application to articles in the set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracings must be fixed; tracing paper not accepted; traced cloth or mounted tracings acceptable; rough sketches not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions on explanatory statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Representations of a design should not be accompanied by any lengthened explanatory statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only brief descriptive statement required to identify whether pattern or shape; avoid verbose descriptions that might complicate registration or identification.
